objective: Daily marked, net excess Sharpe >=2 and total-return CAGR >10 percent; paper qualification only
hypothesis: Distinguish temporary price pressure from persistent information using the composition of recent returns, volume and volatility; learn expected five-session stock returns relative to the market, rather than earnings direction.
data: Existing consistent 503-stock OHLCV cache plus SPY. Current constituents, survivorship-biased; adjusted OHLC and approximate dollar volume. Exploratory screen cannot establish unbiased production performance.
label: Stock next-open to sixth-next-open return minus current trailing126 beta times same SPY return. Winsorize training labels at +/-20 percent. Exact label end strictly precedes each annual training cutoff.
training: 2010 onward, expanding annual retraining, first prediction year 2017. Deterministic every-other training date to limit compute. Training-only feature standardization for Ridge. No parameter search.

models.gradient_boost: HistGradientBoostingRegressor squared_error, max_iter100, max_leaf_nodes15, learning_rate0.05, min_samples_leaf200, l2_regularization10, early_stoppingFalse, random_state20260918

rules.liquidity_shock: Fade one-day beta residual when magnitude >=1.5 trailing20 residual sigma, volume>=1.5 trailing20 mean, overnight residual magnitude<=0.5 trailing20 total sigma. Rank by residual z. Both sides, same holding convention as models.
rules.trend_pullback: Buy most negative five-day residuals among positive 252-skip21 momentum, with residual z5<=-1. Hedge with SPY; no individual-stock shorts.

portfolio: At each close select at most10 longs and10 shorts; models rank predictions centered across eligible names that day, require long>10bps/5 sessions and short<-16bps/5 sessions. Each long or short weight is fixed 1 percent of NAV per cohort (up to0.2 gross). Average holdings from last5 cohort decisions by summing those weights, then add lag-informed SPY dollar-beta hedge and rescale if gross>1. Stock cap5percent, SPY cap60percent. Empty slots stay cash. Next-open fills; mark daily; target updates pay costs. No volatility target or leverage optimization.
eligibility: 252 sessions history, complete finite features, trailing63 adjusted-price dollar volume>$20m, top300 trailing ADV. Beta estimated126 sessions, clipped0to3 for hedging.
cash: Free cash earns French RF; no short-collateral rebate. Conventional Sharpe subtracts same RF. Broker minimums, impact and locates not verified; no production claim even if numerical target met.
selection: Choose highest 2017-2020 excess Sharpe from four candidates before reporting later results; all four shown. Also report one fixed equal-initial-capital blend of all four as a separately counted fifth portfolio.
target_gate: Selected candidate evaluation excess Sharpe>=2 and CAGR>10percent, positive stressed excess mean, positive excess mean in every full evaluation year2021-2024, five-family Bonferroni centered20day bootstrap p<.05. No changing rules after evaluation.
contamination: Equity market periods already studied throughout project. Chronological retraining and purged labels prevent computational leakage but do not create a virgin historical holdout. New live paper data required. All candidate failures retained.
